info.title: Honua Server Management API
info.description: Curated OpenAPI snapshot of key Honua Server administrative endpoints for configuration, import scanning, connections, layers, styles, observability, and deploy control. For full runtime endpoint discovery, use /api/v1/admin/config and the Control Plane guide.

tags.name: Import
tags.description: Migration source scanning and import-adjacent workflows

post.description: Generate an advisory style suggestion for a layer based on data analysis. Community edition returns enhanced geometry-aware defaults. Pro edition attempts field-based classification with smart palette selection, falling back to enhanced geometry-aware defaults when no suitable classification field is available.

Scan a supported GeoServer REST or ArcGIS GeoServices REST source and return a deterministic migration inventory artifact. The response body is the artifact itself and is not wrapped in a success/data admin envelope. A 200 response can still carry scanCompleteness.status = failed when discovery could not complete cleanly; GeoServer currently also uses that failed-artifact path for transport, timeout, auth-related, and other discovery failures instead of surfacing 502/504.

200.description: Migration source inventory artifact, including partial or failed completeness states when discovery could not finish cleanly. GeoServer can also return a failed artifact for transport, timeout, auth-related, or other discovery failures; GeoServices surfaces transport and timeout failures as 502/504.

502.description: Failed to connect to source service. This is currently surfaced for GeoServices scans; GeoServer transport failures return a failed inventory artifact with HTTP 200.

504.description: Source scan timed out. This is currently surfaced for GeoServices scans; GeoServer timeout failures return a failed inventory artifact with HTTP 200.

ApiKeyAuth.name: X-API-Key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API Key authentication for admin operations. Evaluated when Bearer is not selected.

BearerAuth.description: OAuth2/OIDC bearer token authentication. If a Bearer header is present and OIDC is enabled, Bearer takes precedence over API key fallback.

BasicAuth.description: Optional HTTP Basic compatibility mode for legacy clients (requires HTTPS in production). Basic is used only when compatibility mode is enabled and API key auth did not succeed.

Conflict.description: Conflict - resource state prevents the requested operation

manifestSupported.description: Whether metadata manifest export and apply are supported

manifestDryRunSupported.description: Whether manifest apply dry-run is supported

manifestPruneSupported.description: Whether manifest apply prune is supported

serverVersion.description: Server version reported by the runtime build

releaseChannel.description: Release channel derived from build metadata

metadataSchemas.description: Supported metadata schema versions and their deprecation markers

basePath.description: Versioned base path for the control-plane API major

deprecated.description: Whether the control-plane API major is deprecated
Whether the metadata schema version is deprecated

metadataResources.description: Whether metadata resource CRUD endpoints are supported

manifestDryRun.description: Whether manifest apply dry runs are supported

manifestPrune.description: Whether manifest apply prune is supported

CreateConnectionRequest.description: Provide either password or secretReference/secretType. Do not provide both.

connectionId.description: Tested connection ID (empty UUID for draft tests)

fields.description: Subset of fields to publish (empty publishes all)

status.description: Top-level coordinated deployment status for this instance

readyForCoordinatedDeploy.description: Whether the instance is ready to participate in a coordinated rollout

message.description: Operator-facing summary for the current preflight result

serverVersion.description: Current Honua server version. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

environment.description: Current ASP.NET host environment. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

deploymentMode.description: Configured Honua deployment mode. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

instanceName.description: Machine or instance name serving the request. Only present when includeDiagnostics=true.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the payload was generated

isCompatible.description: Whether the database meets Honua compatibility requirements

postGisRasterVersion.description: PostGIS raster extension version, if installed

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings from the compatibility check

errorMessage.description: Error message when the compatibility check determined incompatibility

isReady.description: Whether the instance is currently ready to accept traffic

statusCode.description: HTTP status code that would be returned by the readiness endpoint

lifecycleStatus.description: Current migration lifecycle status observed by this instance

upgradeRequired.description: Whether pending migration scripts were detected

pendingScripts.description: Migration scripts that would execute if upgrades were applied now

executedButNotDiscoveredScripts.description: Scripts previously executed against the database but no longer discovered by the current binary

planError.description: Error detail when migration planning could not be completed

sourceKind.description: Source kind alias. Accepted values normalize to either geoserver-rest or arcgis-geoservices-rest in the response artifact.

sourceUrl.description: Source URL to scan. GeoServices requires HTTPS and rejects embedded credentials plus private, loopback, or unresolvable targets. GeoServer follows the same rule outside the test-only unsafe local URL mode.

username.description: Optional GeoServer basic-auth username. Both username and password are required to send GeoServer basic auth; otherwise the scan proceeds anonymously and records a note. Ignored for GeoServices scans.

password.description: Optional GeoServer basic-auth password. Both username and password are required to send GeoServer basic auth; otherwise the scan proceeds anonymously and records a note. Ignored for GeoServices scans.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional scan timeout in seconds. Defaults to 120 for GeoServer and 30 for GeoServices.

includeStyleContent.description: GeoServer-only. Fetches SLD documents for deeper classification and external graphic detection without returning raw style documents in the artifact.

sourceKind.description: Canonical source kind returned by the scanner.

resources.description: Deterministically ordered layers, tables, or layer groups.

styles.description: Deterministically ordered GeoServer styles or GeoServices renderers.

externalDependencies.description: Deterministically ordered external dependencies with sanitized metadata and normalized external URL addresses.

baseUrl.description: Canonical source URL used for the scan.

serviceType.description: Optional service type or protocol subtype.

mode.description: Observed authentication posture, for example anonymous, basic, auth-required, anonymous-or-auth-required, or unknown. GeoServer scans without a complete username/password pair remain anonymous and add an explanatory note.

credentialsSupplied.description: Whether credentials were supplied in the request.

accessConfirmed.description: Whether the scan confirmed source access.

notes.description: Additional posture notes, including anonymous-fallback notes when only one GeoServer credential field was supplied.

status.description: Scan completeness classification. failed can still be returned with HTTP 200 when the source responded but the scanner could not complete inventory generation cleanly.

missingArtifacts.description: Artifact categories that could not be collected.

reason.description: Primary explanation for the assigned compatibility level.

manualSteps.description: Manual follow-up steps needed for migration.

kind.description: Container kind such as workspace or service.

isDefault.description: Whether the container is the source default.

kind.description: Resource kind such as layer, table, or layer-group.

geometryType.description: Reported geometry type when the resource carries geometry.

kind.description: Style kind such as style or renderer.

metadata.description: Deterministic planning metadata for the style or renderer.

resourceId.description: Optional related resource or style identifier.

kind.description: Dependency kind such as datastore, coverage-store, attachments, external-graphic, or external-symbol.

address.description: Dependency address or endpoint when available. External URLs omit embedded credentials, query strings, and fragments.

metadata.description: Deterministic dependency metadata with sensitive values redacted when applicable.

role.description: Role of this spatial reference entry, for example resource, source, extent, declared, or native.

sourceValue.description: Source-provided CRS identifier or text. ArcGIS WKID values remain in source form when the scanner cannot confirm EPSG authority.

crsUri.description: Canonical CRS URI when resolved or safely normalized to EPSG.

credentialReference.description: Secret manager reference (when using external credentials)

isPrimaryKey.description: Whether this is a primary key column

metadataApiVersion.description: Metadata API version supported by the server

apiVersion.description: API version of the manifest payload

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the manifest was generated

driftedResources.description: Resource identifiers that have drifted since the last applied manifest

manifestHash.description: Hash of the manifest content for change detection

dryRun.description: When true, no changes are persisted

prune.description: When true, resources not present in the manifest are removed

dryRun.description: Whether the apply was a dry run

apiVersion.description: API version of the resource schema

kind.description: Resource kind (Service, Layer, Relationship, Style, Connection)

spec.description: Desired state specification (schema varies by kind)

idempotencyKey.description: Client-supplied idempotency key to prevent duplicates

submitImmediately.description: Whether to submit the operation immediately after creation

isReady.description: Whether the instance is ready for traffic

isFailed.description: Whether migration lifecycle state is failed

planAvailable.description: Whether a migration plan could be generated

pendingScripts.description: Migration scripts that would run if upgrades were applied

executedButNotDiscoveredScripts.description: Scripts previously executed but no longer discovered by current binary

planError.description: Error detail when plan generation failed

repositoryUrl.description: Git repository URL (HTTPS, SSH, or git protocol)

manifestPath.description: Relative path for manifest files within the repository

pollIntervalSeconds.description: Poll interval in seconds (floored to server-configured minimum)

approvalRequired.description: Whether changes require approval before applying

pruneEnabled.description: Whether to delete server resources absent from the repository manifest

enabled.description: Whether the watch should be active

before.description: Manifest state before the change (null for first apply)

StyleSuggestionRequest.description: Optional overrides for style suggestion generation.

preferredField.description: Use this field for classification instead of auto-selection. If the field does not exist or is not eligible (e.g. geometry, binary, boolean), the server falls back to geometry-only defaults and includes the reason in the observations array.

preferredMethod.description: Classification method override. Supported values: EqualInterval, Quantile, NaturalBreaks, UniqueValue. Unrecognized values are ignored and the server auto-selects.

preferredPalette.description: Palette name override. Supported values: Viridis, CartoBold, RdBu. Unrecognized values are ignored and the server auto-selects.

classCount.description: Number of classes to generate (default 5). Clamped to the range 2-12.

StyleSuggestionResponse.description: Advisory style suggestion for a layer.

mapLibreStyle.description: MapLibre v8 style document (ready to apply).

classificationMethod.description: Classification method used (null for geometry-only defaults).

paletteName.description: Name of the color palette used.
